purpose: Mixed institutional-attribution tranche: parliamentary evidence provenance, court/prosecution institutions, a media regulator, an international court and a legislative audit body, deliberately covering both adverse and remedial propositions without converting identity into governance.
migrationRule: A dossier may record a proposition involving an institution without classifying every action of that institution. Resolutions, judgments, prosecutions, regulatory acts and audits remain proposition-specific evidence; identity alone creates no ECL outcome or Material Participation finding.
visualRule: Derived visuals show the source proposition and terminate at the institution identity boundary. State R/S context, adverse conduct adjacency and counter-evidence adjacency are all non-propagating.
